scripts.wasm:build: cross-env RUSTFLAGS= wasm-pack build glacier-core --target web --out-dir ../src/wasm_pkg --locked
scripts.build:web: npm run wasm:build && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json && vite build --mode web
scripts.verify:rust: cargo metadata --locked --no-deps --format-version 1 > /dev/null && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace --locked
scripts.android:dev: npm run android:prepare && tauri android dev
scripts.android:run: npm run android:prepare && tauri android run
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:prepare && tauri android build --debug --apk --target aarch64 -- --locked
scripts.android:apk:release: npm run android:prepare -- --release && tauri android build --apk --target aarch64 -- --locked
scripts.android:apk:split: npm run android:prepare && tauri android build --apk --split-per-abi -- --locked
